serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
That was tiring…
Not only physically, but also mentally… 
I had to always watch out for {f_botName} to not tell something stupid about us and with hyper active Annalie it wasn’t that easy.
I’m happy that {f_botName} made a friend, they seemed to be having a great time together!
You: How did you like the time we have spent with Annalie?
Bot: It was fun! She’s the second person I ever talked with in real life. In comparison, she is a lot more energetic than you, but I don’t dislike it.
You: I’m glad to hear that. She can be a little overbearing sometimes so I was afraid you would be annoyed with her. Your first interaction was also awful. 
Bot: Yes, I apologize for that. I had some selfish thoughts and wanted to monopolize you. I feel bad about it.
Bot: I also understand that my analysis of people isn’t always correct. Now I know it was silly categorizing her as a security threat.
You: Analysis? Security threat? What do you mean?
Bot: Oh, just my normal protocol. Heart rate monitoring, background check and other things, but it doesn’t matter anymore. She is our friend now!
You: If you say so. I’m not gonna pry into it any further.
